question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a white present, Bob has a teal present, Claire has a silver present, Dave has a orange present, Eve has a black present, Fred has a red present, and Gertrude has a brown present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Eve and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Dave swap their gifts. Finally, Gertrude and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Fred has the
Options:
(A) white present
(B) teal present
(C) silver present
(D) orange present
(E) black present
(F) red present
(G) brown present
solution:
Gift colors in each row are listed for Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: white, teal, silver, orange, black, red, brown
1. Eve ↔ Dave: white, teal, silver, black, orange, red, brown
2. Claire ↔ Fred: white, teal, red, black, orange, silver, brown
3. Eve ↔ Dave: white, teal, red, orange, black, silver, brown
4. Claire ↔ Fred: white, teal, silver, orange, black, red, brown
5. Dave ↔ Gertrude: white, teal, silver, brown, black, red, orange
6. Bob ↔ Dave: white, brown, silver, teal, black, red, orange
7. Gertrude ↔ Bob: white, orange, silver, teal, black, red, brown
Fred has the red present, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
